A LITTLE MORE TIME. A LITTLE FURTHER AFIELD.

Indigenous Peoples’ Day / Columbus Day weekend

For Oct. 10-12, prioritize rail-friendly Hudson Valley plans for Saturday/Sunday and reserve Monday for places explicitly open on the holiday. Do not rely on car-trip timing for the long weekend without rechecking traffic, and book timed-entry/tour slots where venues recommend it.

Roughly a three-hour drive from NYC in normal conditions; holiday traffic may take longer. Nothing here is a reservation.

day trip

Beacon: Dia Beacon plus an opening-weekend concert

Strong car-free art day: Dia Beacon is next to the Metro-North Beacon stop, is open Friday-Monday 10 a.m.-5 p.m., and has Isang Yun: Images at Dia Beacon on Saturday, Oct. 10 at 2 p.m., free with museum admission but with limited seating and separate event registration.

CAR-FREE: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Beacon; Dia says trains run hourly during museum hours and the museum is an 8-10 minute walk from Beacon station. CAR-OPTIONAL: Dia lists approximate NYC driving time as 80 minutes in normal conditions.

Advance Dia reservations are suggested but not required; event seating is limited and registration is separate. Arrive before 4:30 p.m. for admission. On-site parking is limited on busy weekends and holidays.

Destination & details ↗Transport ↗

day trip

Cold Spring: West Point Foundry Preserve and river-village wandering

A low-friction car-free nature/history day: West Point Foundry Preserve is a free, year-round outdoor museum with interpretive trails through a National Historic Landmark industrial site, and Cold Spring’s compact Main Street is walkable from Metro-North.

CAR-FREE: Metro-North Hudson Line to Cold Spring, then walk to the village and preserve area. CAR-OPTIONAL: driving is possible, but parking and holiday traffic should be rechecked.

The preserve is free and open year-round dawn to dusk. Putnam History Museum is open Wednesday-Sunday 12-4 p.m. during open season, so it fits Oct. 10-11 but not the Monday holiday unless the museum posts a special opening.

Destination & details ↗Transport ↗

overnight

Hudson and Olana: one-night art, architecture, and river views

Best overnight pick: stay in Hudson, use the weekend for galleries/food, and reserve Olana for its 250-acre designed landscape and house tours. Olana’s page specifically notes tours open Monday Oct. 12, while the park is open daily 8 a.m. to sunset.

CAR-FREE WITH LOCAL TRANSFER: Amtrak Empire Service normally serves Hudson, then use taxi/rideshare/local transport to Olana; Amtrak pages were blocked in this research, so exact schedules remain unconfirmed. CAR-OPTIONAL: driving keeps Olana and nearby villages easier, but recheck long-weekend traffic.

Olana says tours sell out quickly and advanced reservations are strongly recommended. Arrive 30 minutes before any tour and leave 30 minutes between multiple tour experiences.

Destination & details ↗Transport ↗

day trip

Storm King Art Center: large-scale outdoor sculpture in peak October season

A distinctive outdoor art-and-landscape day with enough scale to feel like a real escape. Storm King is open Wednesday-Monday, closed Tuesdays, with October weekend early opening noted on the visit page.

CAR-REQUIRED RECOMMENDED: onsite parking address is 20 Old Pleasant Hill Rd., New Windsor, NY. LIMITED CAR-FREE OPTION UNCONFIRMED: Storm King says Coach USA offers round-trip Port Authority service, but the Coach USA product page fetched as no matching tours, so verify before relying on it.

Pre-purchased tickets are essential to guarantee admission and parking; onsite tickets may be limited or unavailable for certain time slots. Final entry is 5 p.m.; no overnight parking.

Destination & details ↗Transport ↗

day trip

Grounds For Sculpture: New Jersey sculpture park and arboretum

A closer, highly practical art/nature alternative if Hudson Valley ticketing or weather looks awkward: 42 landscaped acres, 300-plus sculptures, indoor galleries, and year-round programming.

CAR-REQUIRED OR TRANSIT-PLUS-RIDESHARE: drive directly, or use NJ Transit rail planning to Hamilton/nearby stations and arrange the final local transfer. This is not a clean door-to-door car-free option unless the local transfer is preplanned.

Admission tickets are non-refundable but may be rescheduled if capacity allows; tickets are released on a rolling basis. The fetched official pages did not surface holiday-specific hours, so confirm Oct. 10-12 hours before buying.

Destination & details ↗Transport ↗

Stay in the city

  • Brooklyn Botanic Garden fall garden day2026-10-10 to 2026-10-12 · BBG’s October hours list Tuesday-Sunday 10 a.m.-6 p.m. and specifically say it is open Monday Oct. 12, 10 a.m.-6 p.m.; advance tickets are recommended and all visitors need tickets.
  • Dia Chelsea: free Chelsea art stop2026-10-10 · Dia Chelsea is free, open Wednesday-Saturday 12-6 p.m., and closed Sunday-Monday, so Saturday is the window. It currently lists David Lamelas: The Machine on view and public tours every second Saturday at 1 p.m., with reservations suggested but not required.
  • NYC Columbus Day Parade planning page2026-10-12 · The Columbus Citizens Foundation’s official page is updated for the 2026 Columbus Day Parade and says they look forward to the parade in 2026, but the fetched page did not provide a confirmed step-off time or route; use it only after checking final details.
  • NYBG Fall-O-Ween as a Bronx fall fallback2026-10-10 to 2026-10-12 · NYBG’s official Fall-O-Ween page describes seasonal pumpkins, gourds, fall flowers, special weekends, and evening light-trail programming; the fetched page did not expose exact Oct. 10-12 schedule details, so verify admission category and Monday opening before going.

Before you commit

  • Confirm each venue’s Oct. 10-12 hours the week of travel, especially Monday Oct. 12 holiday exceptions.
  • For Dia Beacon, register separately for Isang Yun: Images if choosing the Oct. 10 concert; admission alone may not guarantee seating.
  • For Olana, book house/landscape tours in advance and confirm the Monday Oct. 12 special tour opening on the ticketing page.
  • For Storm King, pre-purchase timed admission/parking and verify whether the Coach USA package is actually bookable; do not assume a car-free route.
  • For Hudson/Olana, Amtrak official pages were blocked during research, so verify train schedules directly before treating the overnight as car-free.
  • For all car trips, recheck same-day traffic because the requested roughly-three-hour radius is normal-traffic only, not a long-weekend guarantee.
  • For NYC parade or Indigenous Peoples’ Day programming, verify final official route, time, and organizer pages; several city/community pages were blocked or unavailable in this research.

4:00 PMFree

MoMA free Friday evening

Museum of Modern Art

Midtown · Manhattan

MoMA offers free admission on Friday evenings. Free tickets are limited, released in advance, and go quickly.

Good to know & sources

Timing: Free Friday evenings, roughly 4-8pm. Confirm the current window and ticket release on moma.org.

Before you go: Book the free timed ticket the moment it is released; the line for walk-ups is long.

Why this pick: A standing weekly free window at a museum that is otherwise one of the most expensive in the city.

Scores and review counts come from public listings, not an AI opinion or a combined score. Each snapshot shows its actual check date; numbers older than seven days are hidden. Small samples are marked.

Expired offers are removed; updates older than seven days are hidden until rechecked.
